subject.title: [Bug]: OpenClaw Gateway incorrectly reports false "Codex subscription usage limit" while Codex CLI works with the same ChatGPT OAuth account

question: Should this issue require an exact-model Codex CLI/app-server trace before maintainers treat the response as an OpenClaw false positive?
rationale: OpenClaw follows an explicit upstream error code, but the existing successful CLI command did not select the Gateway model, so the current evidence is insufficient to choose a safe code change.

options.title: Require matched trace
options.body: Request a direct `codex exec --model gpt-5.5` comparison plus redacted app-server diagnostics before scoping a fix.

options.title: Reproduce internally
options.body: Have a maintainer with the same subscription setup capture both exact-model paths and the raw app-server error.

recommendation.title: Require matched trace
recommendation.body: Request a direct `codex exec --model gpt-5.5` comparison plus redacted app-server diagnostics before scoping a fix.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest feature-history trail is the canonical OAuth routing and bridge-hardening work directly governing this path.
